name: NAD83(FBN)
area: American Samoa - Tutuila, Aunu'u, Ofu, Olesega, Ta'u and Rose islands - onshore. Guam - onshore. Northern Mariana Islands - onshore. Puerto Rico - onshore. United States (USA) - conterminous (contiguous) lower 48 states (CONUS) onshore plus Gulf of Mexico offshore continental shelf (GoM OCS). US Virgin Islands - onshore.
remarks: In Continental US (excludes Alaska) and Hawaii, replaces NAD83 for applications with an accuracy of better than 1m. In Continental US, Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands replaced by NAD83(NSRS2007). In American Samoa and Hawaii replaced by NAD83(PA11).
